message: Nanaka was nowhere to be seen during our special training.
Just having Nanaka absent makes things feel weirdly lonely.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, Mr. Sengen'in called me in for a bit.」
Ah... must be because she was right on the verge of failing...

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aw, bummer. And here I went to all the trouble of transforming, too. Well, let's clean up--」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on! Everyone, don't undo your transformations!」
Still, to us--who had defeated Pasta, one of the Seven Demon Generals--they weren't scary at all.
